Proposed next step: 30-minute walkthrough (product + short technical Q&A). Please pick whichever of these works for your team; we can add/replace slots if necessary:
- Option 1: Tue Jun 8, 2:00–2:30pm PT (5:00–5:30pm ET)
- Option 2: Wed Jun 9, 9:00–9:30am PT (12:00–12:30pm ET)
- Option 3: Thu Jun 10, 11:00–11:30am ET (8:00–8:30am PT)

Who we'd include from Redwood: me (sales), Marissa Cole (solutions engineer — short demo + config notes), Priyom Das (CS — onboarding/timeline). Who we'd expect from Polaris: product owner, infra lead (for network/latency constraints), and any compliance lead for SOC2 Qs.

Attachment: redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (stub) — brief agenda and rough attendee roles.

If you prefer a longer technical deep-dive instead of the 30-min intro, say so and we’ll propose a 60–90 minute slot with an infra deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something.
